diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The agent found only 8 contributors for q1 (CoachForce Market Research Report authors + key reviewers) but the expected answer has 11. The agent limited itself to meeting participants of a single planning meeting, missing additional authors/reviewers evidenced in other artifacts (e.g., document author lists, PR reviewers, chat threads, additional review meetings). The skill's 'key reviewer extraction rules' section needs to be strengthened to require exhaustive multi-artifact aggregation of all authors AND all reviewers/contributors with substantive feedback across every related artifact (not just one meeting), and to explicitly warn against under-counting by stopping at the first review meeting.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill's product-grounding and reviewer-extraction guidance correctly steered the agent to the right product (CoFoAIX) but caused under-collection: the agent returned only 8 participants from one planning meeting instead of aggregating authors + reviewers across ALL related artifacts (multiple meetings, PRs, docs, chat threads). The skill does not explicitly require exhaustive union across every artifact that references the target document, nor does it instruct the agent to continue searching after finding a 'review meeting' that looks complete.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update the 'Key reviewer extraction rules' section to require: (1) enumerate ALL authors listed in document metadata (authors field may contain multiple eids); (2) collect reviewers/contributors from EVERY artifact that references the target document — including all meetings whose document_type or topic matches, all PRs touching the document, all chat threads/channels discussing it, and any explicit 'reviewers'/'approvers' fields; (3) take the UNION of eids across all such artifacts, deduplicated; (4) do NOT stop after a single review meeting — explicitly search for additional review/planning/feedback meetings and PR review events; (5) include contributors who provided substantive feedback in chat threads, not only meeting participants. Add a worked example showing how 11 eids are assembled from multiple sources (e.g., 3 authors from doc metadata + 7 participants from meeting_1 + 2 additional reviewers from meeting_2/PR, deduplicated to 11). Add a checklist step: 'Before finalizing the eid list, re-grep the dataset for the document_id/codename and list every artifact found; confirm no artifact's contributors are omitted.'
